name: Supreme Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Supreme Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the import and export dealership of electronic products and components in Taiwan, Hong Kong, China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers memory products and solutions, such as DRAM, flash, and mobile solutions; system LSI products and solutions; mobile and display LED's; multilayer ceramic capacitors; polarizers and batteries; cold plate and direct liquid cooling, and immersion cooling products; and encoders, TV decoders, DVI encoders, and LVDS encoders.
